verdict.rationale: Docs describe 'Ask Rippling' AI surfacing answers on devices/threats/compliance and generating audit-ready reports, plus AI-driven automation like triggering retrieval flows and routing returned devices, indicating genuine AI-generated insights/suggestions from platform data. However, evidence is entirely vendor marketing copy with no hands-on/independent corroboration of accuracy, scope, or reliability of these insights. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the AI insight quality, broader examples beyond devices/inventory (e.g., identity/compliance insights in practice), and detail on how suggestions are presented/actioned.
